dialogues.speaker: Nataba
dialogues.text: Hey there! Could I interest you in buying a "sun"...? Oh, it's you! Are you satisfied with the "sun" you bought?

dialogues.speaker: Nataba
dialogues.text: We've known each other for so long, we're practically good friends by now. Hey, if you'd like, I can sell you the recipe for making more "suns."
